split_reasoning: Editing copy and supervising other editors are different activities.

split_reasoning: Checking spelling, punctuation, and syntax is one proofreading activity.

split_reasoning: Allocating space among text and visual elements is one layout-planning activity.

parts.start: content and available space identified
parts.end: allocation recorded or communicated to layout staff

split_reasoning: Planning publication contents against editorial and publishing requirements is one activity.

parts.start: copy identified for fact-checking
parts.end: verification findings and needed corrections communicated

split_reasoning: Reviewing and approving a production proof are steps in one proof-approval activity.

parts.unit_reasoning: The submitted proof is the unit returned to production.
parts.work_item: one production proof reviewed for approval
parts.start: proof submitted by production
parts.end: proof approved or returned with corrections

split_reasoning: Developing audience-oriented story and content ideas is one activity.

parts.work_item: one story or content idea developed for consideration

parts.end: idea or pitch presented to the editorial team

split_reasoning: Overseeing artwork, layout, typesetting, and printing is continuing production coordination; its actionable outputs are individual production issues resolved or escalated.

split_reasoning: Discussing placement and emphasis of developing stories is one live editorial consultation.

parts.type_reasoning: The target describes the live discussion rather than a separate documented deliverable.

split_reasoning: Assigning topics, events, and stories are variants of the same assignment activity.

split_reasoning: Evaluating and editing submitted material produces an editorial output, while conferring with authors is a separate live interaction.

split_reasoning: Monitoring news-gathering is continuing work; its actionable output is a source or coverage gap identified and addressed.

split_reasoning: Meetings with different production and marketing personnel serve the same project-discussion activity.

split_reasoning: Supervising and coordinating reporters and editors are closely related management interactions.

parts.text: Supervise and coordinate the work of reporters and other editors.

split_reasoning: Acceptance and revision recommendations are alternative outcomes of one manuscript assessment.

parts.type_reasoning: The assessment produces a recommendation for a publisher's decision.
parts.unit_reasoning: Each submitted manuscript receives its own recommendation.
parts.work_item: one manuscript acceptance or revision recommendation

split_reasoning: Selecting wire items from different geographic levels is the same editorial selection activity.

parts.work_item: one wire news item selected for use

split_reasoning: Interviewing candidates, making hiring decisions, and negotiating author or freelancer terms are different activities.

split_reasoning: Setting publication policy and directing departments are distinct policy and management activities.
